references.text: The description of the peace offering (shelamim) and the various animals that could be sacrificed, including cattle, as a basis for the sacrificial practice mentioned here
Detailed rules for the peace offering that Netanel ben Suar follows in his offering
The same offering pattern with two bulls, five rams, five male goats, and five one-year-old lambs was given by Nahshon ben Amminadab
Eliab ben Helon gave an identical peace offering, showing the repeated pattern of gifts from tribal leaders
Netanel ben Suar is introduced as the leader of the tribe of Issachar
Netanel ben Suar is mentioned as the leader of the camp of Issachar
Peace offerings were sacrificed at the covenant ceremony at Sinai, serving as a background for this sacrificial practice
